title: Building trust in AI agents: A production-ready evaluation framework with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
summary: Autonomous AI agents fail softly: latency stays flat while answer quality quietly erodes. This post shares a nine-stage evaluation framework, built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, that catches silent quality regressions across the full agent lifecycle, from first commit to live prod
